newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares fall 1.29 pct after recent rally.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares fall 1.29 pct after recent rally.

text.p: Istanbul shares lost an average 1.29 percent in profit-taking on Wednesday after the recent sharp gains and consequtive record closes, brokers said.
The IMKB-100 closed at 91,602.66, down 1,195.05 points from Tuesday's all-time high of 92,797.71. It plunged to a low of 90,829 in the afternoon from an early high of 94,001.
It had gained 1.13 percent in the last two days on top of last week's 5.49 percent surge and hit seven records in a row.
Trade volume retreated to 16.17 trillion lira ($156.3 million) from 17.61 trillion ($170.4 million) on Tuesday.

"There was a drop in weak volume due to market saturation after the recent strong rises. The index met support at 90,500. It may drift within 90,000-94,000 band for a while," said Nazmi Sarikaya from Disbank.
